title: SpaceBuildPreview
description: space.build-preview@1: where a person's space can be seen right now, as their agent sees it (OpenVibe.Space's builder API; plan 2026-10-22 §Z stage Z1). GET /api/v1/spaces/:id/preview answers { url, files, published }: the address to open (the editor with its live preview while the space is a draft, its own address once it is published), the paths of the files it is made of, and whether it is live.

url.description: Where the space can be seen now.

files.description: The paths of the files the space is made of.
